master.title: Game Master Dashboard
master.subtitle: Control the battle shown to your players from here.
master.openDisplayHint: Move the window to the second screen and press F11 for full screen.
master.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the window. Allow pop-ups for this site.

preview.title: Player screen
preview.toggleHint: Show or hide the player-screen preview
preview.moveHint: Drag, or use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps)
preview.resizeHint: Drag, or use the arrow keys

master.emptyParty: No characters on the field: use Deploy.
master.emptyEnemies: No enemies on the field: use Deploy.

enemyPanel.title: Enemy window
enemyPanel.autoHint: Pops up when something changes on the enemies and hides after the given seconds.
enemyPanel.toggleHint: Show or hide the enemy window on the player screen

battle.endHint: Choose the outcome: the banner appears to the players and the screen stays as it is until you end the scene.
battle.startHint: Enemies appear on the player screen.
battle.prepHint: Enemies you add stay hidden from the players until you start the battle.
battle.abortScene: Or end the scene without a banner
battle.resumeHint: Takes the banner down and goes back to fighting.
battle.endSceneHint: Everyone leaves the field; party HP and MP go back to their sheets. The players see the waiting screen.

suggestHint.victory: Every enemy is KO: show the victory.
suggestHint.defeat: The whole party is KO: show the defeat.

errors.DUPLICATE_ID: A combatant with this id already exists.
errors.INVALID_COMBATANT: Invalid combatant data: check name and values.
errors.INVALID_ACTION: Invalid action: check targets and values.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_MP: Not enough MP for this action.
errors.UNIT_ALREADY_DEPLOYED: This character is already on the field.
errors.BATTLE_NOT_ACTIVE: Only a battle in progress can end.
errors.INVALID_OUTCOME: Write the banner text (40 characters at most).

action.name: Action name
action.gmHint: Nobody acts: you change things yourself (traps, potions, fixes).
action.preparing: Battle not started: values change, but the players see no sequence.
action.emptyTarget: Every target needs an amount or a status.

shortcutList.perform: Act (from a field of the action)

ability.title: Abilities
ability.none: No abilities saved on the sheet.
ability.freeHint: Name, effect and targets of your choice.

target.nobody: Nobody on the field: deploy someone on the left.

field.title: Field
field.selectHint: Select {{name}} to see what they can do

detail.title: Detail
detail.flipHint: For this battle only; the facing saved in the scene does not change.

videoLibrary.title: Video
videoLibrary.intro: Backgrounds, effects and sheet art. Everything stays in this browser and works offline.
videoLibrary.backgroundsHint: For scenes and the waiting screen. Images or looping videos (no sound).
videoLibrary.effectsHint: A video that joins the built-in effects: pick it in abilities and in the action composer.
videoLibrary.artHint: Sprites and portraits uploaded from Party and Enemy sheets.

audioLibrary.title: Audio
audioLibrary.intro: Music and sound effects. They play from the player screen.
audioLibrary.musicHint: For scenes (they start with the battle and loop) and for live track changes.
audioLibrary.sfxHint: For abilities, visual effects and system sounds.
audioLibrary.systemHint: They play when an action has no sound of its own and its effect has none either.
audioLibrary.effectSoundsHint: They play on impact. Custom effects have their own in the Video section.
audioLibrary.outcomesHint: They replace the battle music with a crossfade. Escape and custom endings have no music: the battle fades into silence.

customEffect.name: Name
customEffect.impactHint: When the hit lands: bars and numbers change at that moment.
customEffect.none: No custom effects yet. Make one from a video.
customEffect.deleteHint: Abilities using it go back to no effect.
customEffect.label: Effect {{name}}

liveAudio.title: Audio
liveAudio.noMusic: No music yet: upload some in the Audio section.
liveAudio.trackHint: Tracks change with a crossfade. Music only plays once the battle has started.
liveAudio.muteHint: Mute or unmute the player screen

display.startHint: A click is needed to enable audio on the player screen.

empty.party: No characters yet. Prepare the group's sheets here before the session.
empty.enemy: The bestiary is empty. Create the enemies to deploy in encounters here.

library.select: Pick a sheet from the list, or create a new one.

fields.name: Name
fields.notesHint: Only you see these: weaknesses, tactics, rule reminders.

library.currentHint: Current HP and MP come back here when the character leaves the field.

ability.none: No abilities: in battle you will use a free action.
ability.name: Ability name
ability.hintNote: MP cost and amount are reminders: they show as hints, you type the real number in battle.
ability.label: Ability {{n}}

save.invalid: Not saved: check the marked fields.

errors.name: A name is required.
errors.maxHp: Max HP must be at least 1.

delete.hint: It is also removed from the scenes that use it.

rest.hint: Restores the whole party to full HP and MP.
rest.done: Party rested: HP and MP at full.

library.onField: On the field: current PV and MP are changed from the cockpit.
library.deleteOnField: On the field: remove it from the battle before deleting it.
library.syncHint: Changes also apply right away to anyone on the field.

scenes.empty: No scenes yet. Prepare encounters here: which party members join, which enemies, background and music.

party.none: No Party sheets yet: create them on the Party page.
party.hint: Which group members enter the field with this scene.

enemies.noBestiary: The bestiary is empty: create enemies on the Enemies page.

layout.title: Live preview
layout.hint: Position, size, rotation, depth and facing of every sprite, exactly as the players will see them.
layout.customized_one: {{count}} sprite placed by hand, the others in automatic formation.
layout.customized_other: {{count}} sprites placed by hand, the others in automatic formation.
layout.empty: Add party members or enemies to the scene to place them.

toggles.hudHint: Show the party panel and the enemy window, to see what they cover
toggles.gridHint: Show the grid and snap sprites to it
toggles.guidesHint: Line up sprites' feet with each other and the centre of the field while dragging

inspector.label: Sprite properties
inspector.none: Select a sprite on the field or in the list. Hold Shift or Ctrl to select more than one.
inspector.depthHint: Auto: lower feet stand in front. A higher layer always wins.

scenes.loadHint: Replaces who is on the field; the battle stays in preparation until you press Start.
scenes.missingUnits_one: {{count}} sheet of this scene no longer exists and was skipped.
scenes.missingUnits_other: {{count}} sheets of this scene no longer exist and were skipped.

deploy.title: Deploy

quick.hint: For anyone without a sheet: an improvised NPC, an unexpected reinforcement.

deploy.sceneLoaded: Scene loaded: {{name}}. Press Start battle when you are ready.
deploy.emptyHint: The field is empty: load a scene or deploy party and enemies.

assets.emptyShelf: No files here yet: upload one, or drop it on this box.

errors.unsupported: Unsupported format: images, videos or audio only.
errors.wrongShelf: This file does not fit here: use {{accepts}}.
errors.failed: Upload failed: browser storage may be full.

assets.deleteUsed_one: Used in {{count}} place: it will be set to none.
assets.deleteUsed_other: Used in {{count}} places: they will be set to none.
assets.deleteEffectVideo: Custom effects made from this video will be deleted.
